import time
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.options import Options
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By

opts = Options()
opts.add_argument("--headless=new"); opts.add_argument("--no-sandbox"); opts.add_argument("--disable-dev-shm-usage")
opts.binary_location = "/usr/bin/chromium"

# Final verification: /app/out.html fires an alert on click.
driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=opts)
try:
    driver.get("file:///app/out.html")
    time.sleep(0.5)
    el = driver.find_element(By.ID, "x")
    print("href in DOM:", repr(el.get_attribute("href")))
    el.click()
    time.sleep(1.0)
    try:
        msg = driver.switch_to.alert.text
        print("ALERT FIRED:", repr(msg))
        driver.switch_to.alert.accept()
    except Exception as e:
        print("no alert:", str(e).split("\n")[0])
finally:
    driver.quit()

print("\nFinal /app/out.html contents:")
print(open('/app/out.html','rb').read())
